heading: Learn Norwegian from first words to C1.
lead: Norwegian Bokmål as it is taught to adults in Norway, with the pronunciation of standard East Norwegian, in 76 modules across eight tiers: from pitch accent, the three genders and the present tense to the passives, nominal style, academic Norwegian, the dialects and Nynorsk. Grammar is explained directly, and every answer gets feedback with a reason.
fineprint: The whole course, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free. Specializations, Norskprøven and Bergenstesten practice papers and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

panel.label: The course, tier by tier

items.title: 1 · Sounds and first words
items.text: Pronunciation and pitch accent, greetings, the three genders, the present tense, numbers.

items.title: 2 · Everyday basics
items.text: Definite forms, plurals, adjectives, verb-second word order, questions, possessives after the noun.

items.title: 3 · Daily life
items.text: Verb classes, modal verbs, prepositions of place, food, the city, shopping.

items.title: 4 · The past
items.text: The past tense and the perfect, strong verbs, the future, reflexives, travel and health.

items.title: 5 · Building fluency
items.text: Subordinate clauses, particle verbs, comparison, double definiteness, the passive.

items.title: 6 · Intermediate
items.text: Relative clauses, the conditional, reported speech, participles, modal particles.

items.title: 7 · Upper intermediate
items.text: Choosing the passive, nominal style, connectors, word formation, official Norwegian.

items.title: 8 · Advanced
items.text: Advanced word order, style, spoken Norwegian, dialects and Nynorsk, academic Norwegian.

panel.note: 76 modules in all. A placement test lets you start further up if you already know some Norwegian.

sections.heading: A course built for adults who want to understand the language

items.title: Grammar explained, not hidden
items.text: Each grammar module states the rule: when a noun takes en, ei or et, why the verb comes second, where ikke goes in a subordinate clause. The grammar reference keeps every rule in one place.

items.title: Bokmål as Norwegians write it
items.text: The course teaches three genders with the a-forms most Norwegians use for everyday feminine nouns (jenta, boka), and says from the start that boken is correct too. Answers accept both wherever both are correct.

items.title: Dialects and Nynorsk
items.text: Norwegians speak their dialect at work and on television. The course notes dialect forms you will hear, and Tier 8 teaches dialects and Nynorsk for recognition and reading. You are never asked to produce dialect.

items.title: Feedback that says why
items.text: A wrong answer is marked with the correct form and the reason, with a link to the rule. Answers are graded on the server, the same way every time.

items.title: Every word inspectable
items.text: Tap any Norwegian word in an exercise, text or story for its meaning, its forms and audio.

items.title: Speaking with pronunciation feedback
items.text: Norwegian has pronunciation assessment, so the course includes exercises where you say a word or a sentence and get feedback on each word, with notes on pitch accent and vowel length where they matter.

sections.heading: Practice papers for Norskprøven and Bergenstesten
sections.intro: The course has two timed practice papers for each level of Norskprøven, HK-dir's test of Norwegian for adult immigrants, and for Test i norsk – høyere nivå (Bergenstesten), with original content. The Norwegian exams page says what they cover and where they differ from the real tests.
items: Norskprøven A1–A2, A2–B1 and B1–B2: reading, listening and writing, with the writing at full length.
Norskprøven C1 (høyere akademisk nivå): the summary of a long conversation and the argumentative text of Part 1, at full length.
Bergenstesten: all five sub-tests of the written test, shorter than the real one.
No oral part, and no level or pass mark: the papers show the share of points only.

sections.heading: Norwegian for your field
sections.intro: Thirteen specialization courses, each with nine modules in three stages (foundations, working vocabulary, professional) that open as you reach Tiers 4, 6 and 8 of the core course:

items.question: Is the Norwegian course really free?
items.answer: Yes. All 76 modules from A1 to C1, the grammar reference, word practice, the common traps and the placement test are free, with 5 Ask AI questions a day. Premium adds the specializations, exam papers, stories, conversations and the other extras.

items.question: Bokmål or Nynorsk?
items.answer: Bokmål, the written standard most Norwegians use, with the pronunciation of standard East Norwegian. Nynorsk is explained from the first module and taught for reading in Tier 8.

items.question: I already know some Norwegian. Do I have to start from the beginning?
items.answer: No. The placement test tells you which tier to start from.

items.question: Does it prepare for Norskprøven?
items.answer: It has two timed practice papers for each level of Norskprøven and for Bergenstesten. There is no oral part, which is the part UDI asks for in applications for citizenship and permanent residence, and the papers do not estimate your level. The Norwegian exams page has the details.

items.question: I speak Swedish or Danish. Is there a version for me?
items.answer: Yes. Norwegian for Swedish speakers (40 modules) and Norwegian for Danish speakers (29 modules) are shorter courses, with explanations in Swedish or Danish, that build on what your language already gives you and spend their time on what is different.
